verses.geez: ስምዑ፡ ዘንተ፡ ቤተ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ እለ፡ ተሰመይክሙ፡ በስመ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወእለ፡ ወፃእክሙ፡ እምይሁዳ፤ እለ፡ ትምሕሉ፡ በስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወተዘከርክሙ፣፡ አኮ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወአኮ፡ በርትእ።
verses.translation: Hear these words, ye house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and have come forth out of Juda, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, making mention of it, but not with truth, nor with righteousness;

translations.lxx: Hear these words, ye house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and have come forth out of Juda, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, making mention of it, but not with truth, nor with righteousness;
translations.kjv: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi aceasta, voi, cei din casa lui Iacov, care purtaţi numele lui Israel, voi cei ieşiţi din sămânţa lui Iuda, care vă juraţi pe numele Domnului şi vă lăudaţi cu Dumnezeul lui Israel, dar nu întru credincioşie şi dreptate.

verses.geez: ወትሰመዩ፡ በስመ፡ ሀገር፡ ቅድስት፡ ወታሰምኩ፡ በአምላከ፡ እስራኤል፤ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ ስሙ።
verses.translation: maintaining also the name of the holy city, and staying themselves on the God of Israel: the Lord of hosts is his name. The former things I have already declared;

translations.lxx: maintaining also the name of the holy city, and staying themselves on the God of Israel: the Lord of hosts is his name. The former things I have already declared;
translations.kjv: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts is his name.
translations.ron: Căci voi purtaţi numele cetăţii celei sfinte şi vă bizuiţi pe Dumnezeul lui Israel, al Cărui nume este Domnul Savaot.

verses.geez: ዘቀዲሙኒ፡ ነገርኩ፡ ወወፅአ፡ እምአፉየ፤ ወስምዓ፡ ኮነ፡ ዘገበርኩ፡ ግብተ፡ ወበጽሐሂ።
verses.translation: and they have proceeded out of my mouth, and it became well known; I wrought suddenly, and the events came to pass.

translations.lxx: and they have proceeded out of my mouth, and it became well known; I wrought suddenly, and the events came to pass.
translations.kjv: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
translations.ron: "Vestit-am din vremuri străvechi cele ce aveau să se întâmple; din gura Mea au ieşit şi Eu le-am dat de ştire; pe dată le-am făcut şi ce s-au întâmplat,

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ አነ፡ አእመርኩከ፡ ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ አንተ፡ ወዘኀፂን፡ ሥርወ፡ ክሳድከ፡ ወፍጽምከኒ፡ ዘብርት።
verses.translation: I know that thou art stubborn, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy forehead brazen.

translations.lxx: I know that thou art stubborn, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy forehead brazen.
translations.kjv: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
translations.ron: Fiindcă Eu ştiu că tu eşti tare la cerbice ca un drug de fier şi fruntea îţi este de aramă.

verses.geez: ወነገርኩከ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይኩን፡ ወአስማዕኩከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትበል፤ አማልክትየ፡ ወግልፎየ፡ ገብሩ፡ ዲቤየ፡ ወስብኮየ፡ አዘዙኒ።
verses.translation: And I told thee of old what should be before it came upon thee; I made it known to thee, lest thou shouldest say, My idols have done it for me; and shouldest say, My graven and molten images have commanded me.

translations.lxx: And I told thee of old what should be before it came upon thee; I made it known to thee, lest thou shouldest say, My idols have done it for me; and shouldest say, My graven and molten images have commanded me.
translations.kjv: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
translations.ron: Ți-am prezis acestea înainte ca să se întâmple şi auzite ţi le-am făcut ca să nu zici: "Idolul meu le-a făcut, chipul cel cioplit şi turnat le-a hotărât!"

verses.geez: ሰማዕክሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወኢያእመርክሙ፤ ወአስማዕኩከ፡ ሐዲሰኒ፡ ዘእምይእዜ፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: Ye have heard all this, but ye have not known: yet I have made known to thee the new things from henceforth, which are coming to pass, and thou saidst not,

translations.lxx: Ye have heard all this, but ye have not known: yet I have made known to thee the new things from henceforth, which are coming to pass, and thou saidst not,
translations.kjv: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
translations.ron: Tu ai auzit; priveşte acum toate acestea! De ce nu mărturiseşti? De aci înainte îţi voi împărtăşi lucruri noi, ascunse, pe care nu le ştiai.

verses.geez: ወኢትቤ፤ ይእዜ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ ወአኮ፡ ዘትካት፣፡ ወአኮ፡ ዘቀዲሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ ሰሚዐከ።
verses.translation: Now they come to pass, and not formerly: and thou heardest not of them in former days: say not thou, Yea, I know them.

translations.lxx: Now they come to pass, and not formerly: and thou heardest not of them in former days: say not thou, Yea, I know them.
translations.kjv: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
translations.ron: Ele sunt zidite acum şi nu de atunci; înainte de ziua aceasta tu n-ai auzit nimic despre ele ca să nu zici: "Iată, eu le ştiam!"

verses.geez: ኢያእመርካሁ፡ ወኢለበውካሁ፣፡ ወአኮሁ፡ ዘእምቀዲሙ፡ ከሠትኩከ፡ እዘኒከ፤ ወአእመርኩከ፡ ከመ፡ ክሒደ፡ ትክሕደኒ፡ ሀለወከ፡ እስመ፡ ዓማፂ፡ አንተ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እምከ፡ ተሰመይከ።
verses.translation: Thou hast neither known, nor understood, neither from the beginning have I opened thine ears: for I knew that thou wouldest surely deal treacherously, and wouldest be called a transgressor even from the womb.

translations.lxx: Thou hast neither known, nor understood, neither from the beginning have I opened thine ears: for I knew that thou wouldest surely deal treacherously, and wouldest be called a transgressor even from the womb.
translations.kjv: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
translations.ron: Nu, tu n-ai auzit şi nici n-ai ştiut, atunci urechea ta nu era deschisă; că Eu ştiu că tu eşti necredincios şi că din pântecele maicii tale ai fost numit răzvrătit.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ስምየ፡ አይእየከ፡ መዐትየ፡ ወአመጽእ፡ ግርማየ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያጥፍእከ።
verses.translation: For mine own sake will I shew thee my wrath, and will bring before thee my glorious acts, that I may not utterly destroy thee.

translations.lxx: For mine own sake will I shew thee my wrath, and will bring before thee my glorious acts, that I may not utterly destroy thee.
translations.kjv: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
translations.ron: Pentru numele Meu, Îmi opresc mânia şi pentru slava Mea o potolesc, ca să nu te nimicesc.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ሜጥኩከ፡ አኮ፡ በበይነ፡ ወርቅ፤ ወአውፃእኩከ፡ እምእቶን፡ ዘንዴት።
verses.translation: Behold, I have sold thee, but not for silver; but I have rescued thee from the furnace of affliction.

translations.lxx: Behold, I have sold thee, but not for silver; but I have rescued thee from the furnace of affliction.
translations.kjv: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
translations.ron: Iată că te-am lămurit în foc şi n-am aflat argint, te-am încercat în cuptorul nenorocirii.

verses.geez: በእንቲአየ፡ ረሰይኩከ፡ እስመ፡ አርኰሱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ስምየ፣፡ ወኢይሁብ፡ ስብሐትየ፡ ለባዕድ።
verses.translation: For mine own sake I will do this for thee, because my name is profaned; and I will not give my glory to another.

translations.lxx: For mine own sake I will do this for thee, because my name is profaned; and I will not give my glory to another.
translations.kjv: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
translations.ron: Pentru Mine, şi numai pentru Mine o fac; oare cum voi îngădui ca numele Meu să fie pângărit? Nimănui nu voi da slava Mea!

verses.geez: ስምዐኒ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወእስራኤልኒ፡ ዘአነ፡ ጸዋዕኩከ።
verses.translation: Hear me, O Jacob, and Israel whom I call; I am the first, and I endure for ever.

translations.lxx: Hear me, O Jacob, and Israel whom I call; I am the first, and I endure for ever.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
translations.ron: Ascultă, Iacove, şi tu Israele, pe care te-am chemat. Eu sunt Cel dintâi şi Cel de pe urmă.

verses.geez: ወእዴየ፡ ሣረረታ፡ ለምድር፡ ወየማንየ፡ አጽንዐቶ፡ ለሰማይ።
verses.translation: My hand also has founded the earth, and my right hand has fixed the sky: I will call them, and they shall stand together.

translations.lxx: My hand also has founded the earth, and my right hand has fixed the sky: I will call them, and they shall stand together.
translations.kjv: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
translations.ron: Mâna Mea a întemeiat pământul şi dreapta Mea a desfăşurat cerurile. Eu le chem şi iată ele stau de faţă.

verses.geez: ወይትጋብኡ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወይሰምዑ።
verses.translation: And all shall be gathered, and shall hear: who has told them these things? Out of love to thee I have fulfilled thy desire on Babylon, to abolish the seed of the Chaldeans.

translations.lxx: And all shall be gathered, and shall hear: who has told them these things? Out of love to thee I have fulfilled thy desire on Babylon, to abolish the seed of the Chaldeans.
translations.kjv: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
translations.ron: Adunaţi-vă toţi şi ascultaţi! Care din voi a prezis aceste lucruri? Cel pe care Domnul îl iubeşte va împlini voia Lui împotriva Babilonului şi împotriva seminţiei Caldeilor.

verses.geez: አነ፡ ነበብኩ፡ ወአነ፡ ጸዋዕኩ፣፡ አምጻእክዎ፡ ወረዳእክዎ።
verses.translation: I have spoken, I have called, I have brought him, and made his way prosperous.

translations.lxx: I have spoken, I have called, I have brought him, and made his way prosperous.
translations.kjv: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
translations.ron: Eu, Eu am grăit şi l-am chemat, l-am adus şi l-am făcut să propăşească în calea lui.

verses.geez: ንዑ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወስምዑ፡ ዘንተ፤ አኮኑ፡ እምትካት፡ ኢተናገርኩ፡ ጽሚተ፤ ወአመሂ፡ ኮነ፣፡ ህየ፡ ክመ፡ ሀለውኩ፣፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እግዚእ፡ ፈነወኒ፡ ወመንፈሱ።
verses.translation: Draw nigh to me, and hear ye these words; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning: when it took place, there was I, and now the Lord, even the Lord, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

translations.lxx: Draw nigh to me, and hear ye these words; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning: when it took place, there was I, and now the Lord, even the Lord, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
translations.kjv: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
translations.ron: Apropiaţi-vă de Mine şi ascultaţi acestea: De la început Eu n-am grăit întru ascuns, de când se întâmplă aceste lucruri Eu sunt de faţă". Şi acum, Domnul Dumnezeu mă trimite cu Duhul Său!

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘአድኀነከ፡ ወዘባልሐከ፣፡ ቅዱሰ፡ እስራኤል፤ አነኬ፡ ውእቱ፡ አምላክከ፡ ወአርአይኩከ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ኀበ፡ ትረክብ፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ተሐውር።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord that delivered thee, the Holy One of Israel; I am thy God, I have shewn thee how thou shouldest find the way wherein thou shouldest walk.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord that delivered thee, the Holy One of Israel; I am thy God, I have shewn thee how thou shouldest find the way wherein thou shouldest walk.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
translations.ron: Aşa grăieşte Domnul, Izbăvitorul tău, Sfântul lui Israel: "Eu sunt Domnul Dumnezeul tău Care te învaţă spre folosul tău şi te duce pe calea pe care trebuie să mergi.

verses.geez: ወሶበሰ፡ ሰማዕከ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ እምኮነ፡ ከመ፡ ውኂዝ፡ ሰላምከ፡ ወጽድቅከኒ፡ ከመ፡ ማዕበለ፡ ባሕር።
verses.translation: And if thou hadst hearkened to my commandments, then would thy peace have been like a river, and thy righteousness as a wave of the sea.

translations.lxx: And if thou hadst hearkened to my commandments, then would thy peace have been like a river, and thy righteousness as a wave of the sea.
translations.kjv: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
translations.ron: Dacă ai fi luat aminte la poruncile Mele, fericirea ta ar fi fost asemenea unui râu şi dreptatea ta ca valurile mării.

verses.geez: ወእምኮነ፡ ከመ፡ ኆፃ፡ ባሕር፡ ዘርእከ፡ ወከመ፡ ጸበለ፡ ምድር፡ ትውልደ፡ ከርሥከ።
verses.translation: Thy seed also would have been as the sand, and the offspring of thy belly as the dust of the ground: neither now shalt thou by any means be utterly destroyed, neither shall thy name perish before me.

translations.lxx: Thy seed also would have been as the sand, and the offspring of thy belly as the dust of the ground: neither now shalt thou by any means be utterly destroyed, neither shall thy name perish before me.
translations.kjv: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
translations.ron: Şi va fi seminţia ta ca nisipul mării şi odraslele pântecelui tău ca pulberea pământului. Nimic nu va nimici, nici nu va şterge numele tău înaintea Mea!

verses.geez: ፃእኬ፡ እምባቢሎን፡ እንዘ፡ ትጐይይ፡ እምነ፡ ከላውዴዎን፤ ዜንዉ፡ ቃለ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ወይሰማዕ፡ ዝንቱ፤ ንግሩ፡ እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: Go forth of Babylon, thou that fleest from the Chaldeans: utter aloud a voice of joy, and let this be made known, proclaim it to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath delivered his servant Jacob.

translations.lxx: Go forth of Babylon, thou that fleest from the Chaldeans: utter aloud a voice of joy, and let this be made known, proclaim it to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath delivered his servant Jacob.
translations.kjv: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
translations.ron: Ieşiţi din Babilon, fugiţi din Caldeea cu cântece de veselie! Vestiţi, faceţi cunoscută ştirea, duceţi-o până la marginile pământului! Ziceţi: Domnul răscumpără pe sluga Sa Iacov.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ጸምኡ፡ ማየ፡ በድው፡ ወያወፅእ፡ ሎሙ፡ ማየ፡ እምኰኵሕ፡ ወትነቅዕ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ወይውኅዝ፡ ማይ፡ ወይሰትዩ፡ ሕዝብየ።
verses.translation: And if they shall thirst, he shall lead them through the desert; he shall bring forth water to them out of the rock: the rock shall be cloven, and the water shall flow forth, and my people shall drink.

translations.lxx: And if they shall thirst, he shall lead them through the desert; he shall bring forth water to them out of the rock: the rock shall be cloven, and the water shall flow forth, and my people shall drink.
translations.kjv: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
translations.ron: Şi nu vor suferi de sete în pustiul unde El îi duce; El le izvorăşte apă din stâncă. El despică stânca şi apa ţâşneşte!

verses.geez: ወኢይትፌሥሑ፡ እንከ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: There is no joy, saith the Lord, to the ungodly.

translations.lxx: There is no joy, saith the Lord, to the ungodly.
translations.kjv: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
translations.ron: Nu este pace, zice Domnul, pentru cei fără de lege!"
